abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Iron and +1 to Wits, and -1 to Edge. Throughout the game, you always add +1 to deceive and uncover deception targeting you. You automatically pass any attempt to resist a Jedi-type mind trick. And when you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.0cfcd6fbaf6135d0]{Face Death}, you add +1, and if you fail, you may (once per campaign ONLY) instead suffer a debility and come back from the dead, either through sheer toughness or by revealing that faking your death was all part of your plan.
